notes: Apply every case from a clean state: click #resetBtn, then remove every scenario listed in #scenarioList with its own delete control so the list holds exactly the scenarios given in 'scenarios'.

'base' keys are DOM ids on the Base and Chart tabs. Text inputs with class fmt-num (#purchaseCost, #availableCash, #scFeeAmt, #scAdminFee) take a plain number string: set .value, dispatch 'input' and 'change', then blur. Range inputs (#baseRf, #scRate, #scDownPct): set .value and dispatch 'input' and 'change'. Selects: set .value and dispatch 'change'. Checkboxes (#inflationToggle): click only if the checked state differs from the requested boolean. #inflationRate is a number input, visible only when #inflationToggle is on.

Each entry of 'scenarios' is added by clicking #addScenarioBtn, filling the editor fields by id (#scName, #scRate, #scDownPct, #scFreq, #scTerm, #scFeeAmt, #scFeeType, #scAdminFee) and clicking #saveScenarioBtn. Set #scFreq before #scTerm because a frequency change re-derives the term. #scFeeType takes 'fixed' or 'pct'.
Cases with 'states' are several independent states; apply each from a clean state, and prefix that state's observation keys as listed in 'observe'.

Observables come from: the KPI cards (#kpiBest, #kpiNetBenefit, #kpiInterest, #kpiCashWealth), the Scenario Comparison table in #compTableWrap (find columns by header text), the Amortization Schedule (#amortTabs selects the scenario, table in #amortTableWrap), #warnBanner, #negCarryBanner, #chartLegend, and Chart.getChart(document.getElementById('chartCanvas')) / Chart.getChart(document.getElementById('sensCanvas')) for plotted points. Report numbers as plain numbers (strip currency symbols and thousands separators, keep the sign); report texts verbatim; report a missing quantity as null rather than guessing.
Runner-computed keys ('runner-computed' in 'what') are simple arithmetic on other keys of the same case; compute them from the same values you report.

then: Open scenario A in the editor (its edit control in #scenarioList). With #scTerm reading 24 and #scFreq = monthly, change #scFreq to 'weekly' and record #scTerm and the text of #termLabel (keys term_after_weekly, label_after_weekly).
